caption: Two ref() calls inside customers.sql are the entire reason this DAG exists.

code:
-- you write:
select * from {{ ref('stg_customers') }}

-- compiles to, in dev:
select * from analytics.dbt_yourname.stg_customers

-- same file, compiled for prod:
select * from analytics.dbt_prod.stg_customers
caption: Same file. Different real SQL, depending only on where it's building.
